description: This Dart file defines the ReaderProvider class, which manages the state for reading a book in a Flutter application. It handles loading book details, chapters, bookmarking, and progress tracking, interacting with services for storage and book data retrieval.

classes.name: ReaderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the current reading state including book detail, chapter index, content, progress, and bookmarks.

methods.name: openBook
methods.description: Loads a book detail and initial chapter content, and restores reading progress.

methods.name: _loadChapter
methods.description: Loads the content for the current chapter based on the chapter index.

methods.name: nextChapter
methods.description: Advances to the next chapter and updates progress.

methods.name: prevChapter
methods.description: Goes back to the previous chapter and updates progress.

methods.name: addBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark at a specified position with an optional note, updating storage and local state.
